definitions.explanation: A person or entity against whom a legal action is brought in court. In criminal cases, the person accused of a crime; in civil cases, the party being sued.

examples.japanese: {被告|ひこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無罪|むざい}→無罪：13383_muzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}した→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧。
{被告|ひこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧⟦{三|さん}{年|ねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|くだ}された→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: The defendant was sentenced to three years in prison.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{被告|ひこく}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不十分|ふじゅうぶん}→不十分：05616_fujuubun⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the trial, the defense attorney pointed out the insufficiency of the evidence.

notes:
USAGE:
In criminal trials, the full term is ⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧, but {被告|ひこく} is commonly used in news reports and everyday language. In civil cases, {被告|ひこく} refers to the party being sued.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原告|げんこく}→原告：11085_genkoku⟧: plaintiff (the party bringing the case)
- {被告|ひこく}: defendant (the party being accused/sued)
- ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧: suspect (before indictment)
- ⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧: defendant (formal, criminal law)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被告|ひこく}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the defense side
- {被告|ひこく}⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: the defendant's seat (in court)
- ⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧: the accused (formal)
- {被告|ひこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧: a verdict is handed down to the defendant
